reviews.text: Excellent vets, always great with my wee dog 😊

I’m very happy with the care and service we received from the vet. They have a separate area for cats, which is great and stress-free. The staff were friendly, caring and professional, and they treated my pet with great kindness and patience. Everything was explained clearly, and I felt that my pet was in very good hands.
Thank you to the whole team for your excellent care and for making what could have been a stressful experience much easier. I would definitely recommend this veterinary practice to other pet owners.
Great vets

Writing

I can’t recommend Dave highly enough. He is an exceptional vet extremely knowledgeable, passionate, and caring. He always takes the time to explain everything thoroughly, which gives you complete confidence that your pets are in the best hands. You can genuinely see how much he cares about animals.Dave and his team have looked after my two cats since they were kittens, and I’ve always been very impressed with the care and compassion he shows them. A truly fantastic vet who goes above and beyond. 🐾

Absolute best vet practice around! Dave and the team are so lovely, understanding & always willing to go the extra mile! Girls at reception are always so friendly & welcoming.
Had issues with dressings after my cats got spayed and staff were so eager to find a solution that worked for us and even stayed late so that I could get my girls sorted- wouldn’t want to take them anywhere else!

Amazing ,caring staff ! Both my dogs have been patients since 8 weeks old and I wouldn’t trust their care to anyone else. One of my dogs has ongoing health issues (typical cavalier!) and is so well looked after by all the staff.

As usual Dave and his team were exceptional when I visited with my dogs today. Nothing is too much bother for them and you are made to feel very special. Thanks very much.
Always exceptional staff who are very caring and friendly. Thanks.

East End Vets is one of the best independent vet practices you will ever find. Their ethics are top tier. Their pricing is very competitive. Their service is second to none... its just exceptional. The girls on the desk are always such a delight, no matter how big the problem I've brought them. And then there's Dave, the vet and practice owner. Dave is one very, very special person. You dont meet many people with the heart of gold that Dave has. He is one of the most genuine, understanding, caring and personable vets I have ever come across in my life. Dave listens so intently and always goes above and beyond to provide a range of treatment options to suit the situation without any judgment. I am so grateful to have found him as a vet, and my dogs are extremely lucky to have him too ❤️

Would never use any other vet, David and his fantastic staff have looked after our cats , for past years always show attention too detail , even under some of our sad loses ,at present currently looking after our 3 current cats , best vet by a country mile , prices are reasonable, we have the trusrvet which makes life a lot easier
Came here and was greeted with the most amazing receptionist Chloe she was so lovely and made me feel very welcome.
Friendly staff but very very busy with a relatively small waiting room

The staff have always been very friendly and have gone out of their way to help me and my dog on multiple occasions.
A really great place.

Everyone is great but a special shout out to Jade for helping me get a taxi that would take my big dumb precious dog for about an hour out of the kindness of her heart.
Delicious and beautiful place. The service is very nice. I recommend

I've always had great experiences at East End but Dave goes above and beyond. I've got a young pup and aside from giving great advice and answering all my questions, Dave's kindness and friendliness are very reassuring and put myself and my pup at ease.

I moved here a few years ago with my 3 animals. One of my dogs is reactive and not your usual ‘pet dog’ but Dave and the team do everything to make her visits a positive experience and with as little stress to her.  I have spent tens of thousands on vet bills with a previous vet and dog so I’m acutely aware of some vet pricing and over doctoring as I would call it. Now with my experiences and long animal ownership I always make sure I know all the options and never feel uncomfortable if I want to question. They are always honest and upfront about treatment, alternatives and costs. Nothing but positive experiences here and I recommend them regularly.
Always been a 5 star vet for us. Friendly and professional
We got a Romanian rescue dog and the charity we got her from recommended this vet. Service is amazing all round and their pet plan is great value.

Just at a time when the news was carrying horror stories about vets and pricing.i was lucky enough to find the east end vets.
And it absolutely re instated my faith in the good old independent vet of yesteryear.
My boxer was most definately brought back from the brink of death.
I was and am trully indebted to david and the girls at the practice.the service and attention we got from day 1 was fabulous.this is a surgery who trully goes the extra mile.i cannot thank them enough.krystal.my dog was albeit gone.when i decided to seek second opinion.and after bombarding her with antibiotocs for an absess.i was advised to get bloods tested.she got 3 injections.one antibiotic.one painkiller.and anti inflamatory.at one time she was profusely losing blood after she tore the wound on her neck.
I was advised to euthanase the dog by someone else.yet david.fought.and although were as he said.on a long journey.today.she is 75 percent the boxer i had before the huge absess.or mucocele that was poisoning her system.
I got well advised.well treated.and i write this with hand on heart.i cannot recommend these guys enough.
They are amazing.as i write this my dog krustal is lying in front of the fire.and i got xmas early.
Thoroughly reccomended.i cant speak highly enough.surgery is in my opinion the best practice ive used since my old vet retired 25 years sgo..10 out of ten.

We registered our dog at East End Vet Clinic shortly after it was opened. We actually moved here from different one because of location and Dave's reputation and never regret our decision. I love these people, all of them, they work, empathy, attitude... you name it. Help Sasha always gets here is highly appreciated and we actually grateful they there for us ❤️
Friendly and helpful staff

Best vets ive ever used been using them repeatedly david and liz we have seen so far and both of them genuinely care. Honestly so calming and legitimately listen to you pour ur stress out and so gentle with our cats to the point they purr and want pets cannot recommend them enough
Fantastic place. My girl penny goes here and the staff are fabulous and truly love there job. Trust them completely.

We first moved Jaxon our chihuahua here through word of mouth, and I’m so glad I did. From the very beginning, they treated my boy with the utmost care and love. Davie, Marie, and the entire team have been nothing short of amazing, doing everything they could to try and save our precious boy.

When Jaxon passed away, the kindness and compassion they showed to our family was truly overwhelming. They handled everything with such respect, making an incredibly difficult time that little bit easier to bear.

I’ll forever be grateful for the way they cared for Jaxon and supported us. They are not just brilliant vets — they are genuinely kind-hearted people who treat animals and their families like their own.
The team at East End Vets are always helpful

Excellent receptionist and veterinarian. This is the most polite, best-serviced, and friendliest pet store I've ever seen. I'm Chinese, and my Pomeranian, which I brought from China, was spayed/neutered here very well! Highly recommended! Thanks again to the receptionist! So welcoming!
My cat has seen David for many years and I have always found him and his staff to be very competent, professional and genuinely caring.

A nice well presented vets with an open seating area at the front minimal parking on the street but there is a parking lot right next door.
Friendly and definitely a good service

Dave and  his team go above and beyond to make my cats Fluffie and Carries vet visits as pleasant and informative as they possibly can. They are a wonderful set of individuals who come together as a caring team. I can’t say enough about how great they are. I recommended them to all my petsitting clients who are looking for a new vet practice or maybe a first vet practice.
Pleasent staff. Always quick and helpful. Quiet waiting area. Good service for money.
Kindest vets out there. Their pet plan is also extremely reasonably priced and they don’t overcharge their customers even when everything is getting crazy expensive. Would never go elsewhere
Figaro had his blood test and the vet was kind enough to check him over. All good. Nice, polite, friendly and efficient vet. Good result.
Very good vets
Can’t think Dave enough for the care he has given our dog koby ! Been through a lot and he has always helped us with him. Wouldn’t go anywhere else ❤️
